question: On the representative cases, do X, Y, Z, and rotations convert without an inverted axis, a unit error, or an invented elevation?
answer: Position, orientation, and elevation come from the save. A class with no trustworthy Z or rotation is reported, not drawn as if it were exact.

cases.watch: Cut marks must keep the 32–45 m pole stack, not collapse to one band.
Pillars and lifts sit at different z. Extreme bins elsewhere are not this height.
Very-wide signs must keep off-axis yaw, not snap to 0/90.
Tilted instances ship yaw 0 plus a flat hull. Do not draw that hull as an exact 3D box.
Mk5 belt vertex z climbs ~28 m due north. Chain-actor triples are not this path.
Vanilla class the menu calls Unknown. Place the point; do not invent a shell.
Vertex z climbs ~32 m. Tangent Z is dropped, so vertical curvature between samples is a straight blend.
A field of copies, each with its own pose. Do not collapse onto one point.
Unknown-category pins still have header z. No clearance → report size unknown, do not invent a box.
This 8 m cell spans to ~726 m. That max is not a building height.
